idle_trace.scope: machine_suspend begin through first subsequent device PM callback

battery.measurement_scope: Entire capture, including awake and suspend/resume overhead
battery.power_check_scope: Endpoints only; keep all external power disconnected throughout

assessment: First suspend after normal reboot shows recovery of the long idle pattern and much lower whole-capture power; exact cause of the prior state remains unresolved.
intervening_package_change: Steam and steam-devices removed at 10:39:07 before the 10:48 high-power-boot IRQ capture. That later capture still had the half-second idle exits. Removal alone did not immediately clear them; effects taking effect on reboot cannot be excluded.
current_apps: Chrome/Chromium/Slack process-name query after capture found none. No process inventory was captured during the earlier high-power tests, so app-state equality is not established.
limitations: One successful sleep in the fresh boot does not establish repeated-cycle or overnight reliability.

Whole-capture power is 2.9408 W and includes 25.40 seconds outside suspend, 11.8 percent of capture time. It is not an isolated steady-state sleep measurement and cannot be equated precisely to yesterday’s 1.45 W.
Post-opening wait was ten seconds; battery gauge settling remains uncertain.
Reboot changed driver/hardware initialization and app/session state together; this comparison does not identify which change restored the idle pattern.
next_step: Repeat a short capture in the same boot before changing apps/peripherals, then introduce normal activity incrementally to identify when the half-second pattern returns.
